rules: Use Gemini Flash as the default writer for routine blog content.
Do not silently switch to a paid Gemini tier when free-tier quota/auth fails.
If the free tier is unavailable, return AWAITING_APPROVAL or follow the explicit fallback rules below.
GPT must not be the default writer for bulk routine content.
GPT calls must be tied to an explicit quality or importance signal.
No paid fallback is allowed merely because the primary free tier was exhausted.
Claude is not the default bulk blog writer.
Use Claude primarily for development, code review, system audit, policy review, and complex editorial QA when explicitly requested.

freshness_sensitive_content.rule: Do not generate or queue publish-ready content when current official-source verification is missing.

daily_keyword_research.goal: Discover current high-intent golden keywords before drafting
